scope: Men's singles only. Claims paraphrased; source documents are linked, not redistributed. Verified describes published policy, not each scorecard. Indexed-only retrieval is disclosed.

AO_2019.supports: From 2019, main men's singles best of five, qualifying best of three, with ten-point tiebreak at six-all in final set; replaces advantage final sets.

GS_2022.supports: Harmonization begins at Roland-Garros 2022; includes men's singles and qualifying; ten points at six-all, two-point margin.

WIM_2019.supports: Seven-point tiebreak at twelve-all introduced in 2019. Earlier advantage policy is treated as retrospective inference.

WIM_QUAL_2025.supports: Final men's qualifying round is best of five.
